text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. The all-out final 
push toward the autumn GⅠ campaign begins, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, it's so ridiculous... But why 
does her running make me feel this way...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Truth is, it seems like my 
little brother got into a scrap with a kid 
in the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Boy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Oguri Cap is the strongest of all! 
Her running is on a whole 'nother level! 
Next up is the era of Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
That ain't true! Tama-neene is the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The way Oguri races is strangely popular. 
Though... I kinda get why, myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's real flair to the way she runs. 
Especially on the final stretch, when it 
turns into a razor-thin contest...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It turns into an insanely heated race. 
Overtaking and being overtaken, like 
nobody knows what's gonna happen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter how hyped it gets, a win's 
a win, and a loss is a loss. When I'm 
truly running, I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, how does she manage to run such 
hilarious races...?

Tamamo Cross couldn't seem to get Oguri 
Cap off her mind.

If you're curious, there's only one thing 
to do.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you ask? At this summer training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: At this training camp? To Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I've always wondered what she's 
been carrying on her shoulders as she 
runs."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, listening to it in my room feels 
kind of embarrassing, too. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This autumn—she and I are runnin' in 
totally different races. She's still in 
the Classic tier, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you could at least tell me what 
you're aiming for. Before we race together 
at year's end or next year, that is!”
